Name: TANK_BASE_PARAM
Description: Fields related to tank wheels and treads.

Fields.Name: Animation Speed: Movement Scale
Fields.Description: Wheel animation speed coefficient for forward and backward movement: the movement speed at which the animation completes one loop, in km/h.

Fields.Name: Animation Speed: Rotation Scale
Fields.Description: Wheel animation speed coefficient for turning: the turning speed at which the animation completes one loop, in rad/frame.

Fields.Name: Left: Texture Scroll - Parameter ID
Fields.Description: MaterialExParam row used for the left texture scroll.

Fields.Name: Left: Forward Animation ID
Fields.Description: Animation ID of the wheel part when moving forward

Fields.Name: Left: Backward Animation ID
Fields.Description: Animation ID of the wheel part when moving backwards

Fields.Name: Right: Texture Scroll - Parameter ID
Fields.Description: MaterialExParam row used for the right texture scroll.

Fields.Name: Right: Forward Animation ID
Fields.Description: Animation ID of the wheel part when moving forward

Fields.Name: Right: Backward Animation ID
Fields.Description: Animation ID of the wheel part when moving backwards

Fields.Name: Back Left Wheel ID
Fields.Description: The leftmost rear index in the wheel internal control parameters

Fields.Name: Back Right Wheel ID
Fields.Description: The rightmost rear index in the wheel internal control parameters

Fields.Name: Texture Scroll: Movement Scale
Fields.Description: Texture scroll coefficient for forward and backward movement: the movement speed at which the scroll completes one loop, in km/h.

Fields.Name: Texture Scroll: Rotation Scale
Fields.Description: Texture scroll coefficient for turning: the turning speed at which the scroll completes one loop, in rad/frame.

Fields.Name: Foot IK Interpolation Time
Fields.Description: Interpolation time of the wheel and belt animation when Foot IK is switched on or off. In seconds.
